messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — PR #50199 updates routing fallback + KV prefetch TTL (https://git.redwood/pr/50199). Targeting a canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before I push the final patch. @Sam @Tiago @Olly can you PTAL?
Sam: ok I can look in ~1hr. quick Q: any cluster perf numbers or just local traces?
Maya: only local perf so far — median p50 token latency ~12ms for a 512 seq test. I added a perf snapshot link in the PR and a small trace file. Not confident those reflect the real cluster workload. Also changed default prefetch TTL from 5m -> 1m which might affect eviction churn.
Tiago: noted. I'll take a look at eviction/allocator interactions. If you can add a tiny integration test covering a hot shard split + prefetch eviction that'd speed review.
Olly: security quick-check: authz header ordering is sensitive for a legacy proxy path. Please add a unit test asserting header order and a comment explaining why ordering matters. Also verify no sensitive headers are forwarded to internal debug endpoints.
Sam: glanced at the diff — small nit: prefer explicit nil check before we deref cache handle in router.go. I can post a single-line suggestion. Functionally looks fine but I'd like to see the integration test Tiago requested before LGTM.
Maya: thanks — will push tests + that nil check patch in ~30m. If I get those in, are we OK to schedule canary at 10:00 UTC?
Tiago: yes assuming integration test passes in CI and allocator metrics look normal. I can run a quick allocator smoke locally after you push.
Olly: same — once test + header assertion are in I can sign off for security.
Maya: great — pushing now. I'll update thread when CI finishes. Thanks everyone. :pray:
DeployBot: canary scheduled for PR #50199 at 2025-03-05T10:00:00Z (canary-run-id: cb-175321). CI required: unit, integration, perf-smoke.
Maya: CI passed unit + perf-smoke; integration in progress (queued). leaving this async-cc for any late blockers.
Sam: integration passed on my end. left the tiny suggestion and marked as resolved.
Tiago: allocator smoke looked fine on my local run. no evictions spike.
Olly: security ran the header test, no leaks observed. I can approve once the suggestion is applied.
Maya: applied Sam's suggestion and merged the test fix. tagging owners for final LGTM — @Sam @Tiago @Olly
Sam: LGTM.
Tiago: LGTM.
Olly: LGTM — security ok.
Maya: thanks all, scheduling canary as planned.
